transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on finalizing the delivery package for After the Floodlights. We've got the submission window closing at 5 PM Friday, and our final-delivery meeting is Thursday morning, so we need to make sure everything is locked down before then. The current draft package lists a 52-minute master, 5.1 audio mix, English subtitles, worldwide availability, and a 90-second promotional clip. Does anyone have any concerns or updates before I review and approve the final package?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, before you review and approve the final package, I need to flag a critical issue. I checked the platform's delivery portal after the current draft circulated, and the portal response — which is still in my production inbox awaiting the final-delivery meeting — confirms that this title must be delivered as an exactly 48-minute master with stereo audio and both English and Spanish subtitle files. That conflicts with our current draft, which lists a 52-minute master, 5.1 audio mix, and English subtitles only. We'll need to revise the package before submission.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, before you approve anything, I need to flag a rights issue I confirmed with the documentary's licensing administrator after the current draft circulated. The release is permitted only in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom — not worldwide as the draft currently states. Additionally, any promotional clip may be no longer than exactly 30 seconds, which conflicts with the 90-second clip in our current draft. I haven't yet entered this confirmation in the rights log, but these are binding restrictions we need to reflect in the final package.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the master duration from 52 to 48 minutes, change audio mix from 5.1 to stereo, add Spanish subtitle files alongside English, change availability from worldwide to United States/Canada/United Kingdom, and shorten the promotional clip from 90 seconds to 30 seconds before submitting to the platform.
Confirm the platform portal response specifying 48-minute master, stereo audio, and English/Spanish subtitles is brought to the final-delivery meeting Thursday morning for formal documentation.
Ensure the licensing administrator's confirmation regarding US/Canada/UK territories and 30-second promo clip maximum is entered into the rights log before final submission.
Submit the revised final delivery package with binding instructions before the 5 PM Friday submission window closes.
